content:
Amy (Marketing): Quick sync 1 planning a short webinar to demo the redesigned pricing calculator + metered vs committed estimates. Need to validate microcopy, routing, and tracking.
Ben (Growth): Which microcopy changes are on the table?
Carmen (GTM Research): From research: people interpret 'Committed' as multi-month lock. Suggest change to 'Commit (optional) 1 save more' and add subtext 'month-to-month commitment, cancel anytime'. 6/8 users hesitated on single-word label.
Dave (Product): Backend already returns `metered_est` and `committed_est`. UI should display both with the selected one highlighted. Edge: for >1M embeddings we show cap warning; for webinar, soften to 'Large estimates are indicative; contact sales for tailored pricing.'
Emily (Sales Ops): Routing ask: leads with est_monthly > $1500 -> AE queue. Lower tiers -> nurture or SDR. Need calculator to append `lead_tier` param.
Ben (Growth): Suggest computing est with `est_monthly = tokens_per_month * price_per_1k / 1000`. CTA should add `?utm_source=webinar_calc&lead_route=ae_if_gt_1500` for analytics clarity.
Amy (Marketing): Also want to test CTA label A/B: 'Request demo' vs 'Talk to sales'.
Carmen (GTM Research): Microcopy AB: A='Commit to save 20%'; B='Optional commit saves 20% 1 cancel anytime' 1 prefer B.
Dave (Product): Add tooltip copy: 'Committed assumes steady monthly usage (30-day smoothing).' Also: 'Large-scale estimates may vary depending on model quantization.'
Ben (Growth): I'll mock quick Figma and set tracking events: `calc_open`, `calc_submit`, `compare_clicked`, `lead_route_assigned`.
LaunchBot: deploy queued: `figma-export/price-calc-copy/v3 -> staging` (rollout r-20240311-99).
Emily (Sales Ops): Routing matrix: est < $200 -> nurture@redwood.com; $200-$1500 -> inbound-sdr; > $1500 -> ae-demos. Include model, tokens, commit flag in lead metadata.
Amy (Marketing): Need a mock by EOD for webinar slide.
Ben (Growth): On it; will export screenshot. Also will include small post-calc survey: 'Was this estimate helpful? yes/no'.
Carmen (GTM Research): One-liner for slide: 'Our estimator is a guide. For large deployments we provide tailored benchmarks and pricing.'
Dave (Product): We'll show survey once per browser session. QA on staging tomorrow.
Amy (Marketing): Timeline: mock EOD, QA tomorrow, experiment during webinar traffic Thursday, routing live Friday. Ping here if blockers.
LaunchBot: deployment succeeded: `staging -> price-calc-copy/v3` (sha: def456).
Ben (Growth): Will update lead-hand off doc when routing goes live.
Emily (Sales Ops): Thanks team :rocket:
